messages.subject: DROP LEGEND
parts:
Hi,

I'm trying to build a graphic, but I want to get rid of the legend.

So, I'm running this command:

qplot(displ, hwy, data=mpg, colour=factor(cyl), geom="line")
  opts(drop = "legend_box")

However, R will give me an error message, and the warning:

"drop" is not a valid theme element name.

Does anybody know how to get rid of the legend?

Thanks

messages.author: be51aa06e5a059e2
messages.subject: Re: DROP LEGEND
parts:
use the theme option and set the legend position as following:
theme(legend.position="none")
